title: fix: exclude Mistral ZDR pricing variant
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Excludes the 10%-higher `mistral/zdr` endpoint from the existing OpenRouter Mistral pin.
- Keeps `mistralai/mistral-small-2603`, provider fallback disabled, and the verified standard sheet at $0.15/$0.015/$0.60 per 1M input/cache/output tokens.
- Preserves the canonical name, aliases, capabilities, paid-only access, multiplier, GPU status, and no Pollinations fallback.
- Direct OpenRouter probe selected Mistral and reconciled the standard sheet exactly; the [endpoint catalog](https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/mistralai/mistral-small-2603/endpoints) still lists the ZDR sheet at $0.165/$0.0165/$0.66.
- Local E2E passed text, vision, tools, reasoning, JSON, streaming, every alias, five-request burst, prompt cache, output-cache HIT, wallet/tracking settlement, 41 resolver tests, typecheck, and Biome.

gist.headline: The pricier branch got pruned
gist.blurb: Mistral Small now stays pinned to its verified standard OpenRouter endpoint, rather than wandering into the 10%-higher ZDR variant. The hive checked the receipt twice.
gist.summary: Updated the OpenRouter pin for `mistralai/mistral-small-2603` to exclude the `mistral/zdr` endpoint and consistently use the verified standard $0.15/$0.015/$0.60-per-1M input/cache/output-token pricing sheet.
gist.impact: Paid users and aliases for Mistral Small retain the same capabilities, streaming, tools, vision, reasoning, JSON, and no-fallback behavior while receiving consistent standard-endpoint billing.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful garden keeper pruning a clearly labeled, slightly overgrown `ZDR` branch from a Mistral model-routing plant, leaving a healthy standard-price blossom with a tidy token-price ledger. A cozy retro terminal can show the stable Mistral Small pin and a tiny verified checkmark, with code-plants and flowers reinforcing that routing and pricing have been reconciled.
